extracted.intended_audience: journalists, media professionals, researchers, and the general public seeking NIH news and press resources
extracted.subtask_description: A government news-release index page listing NIH news releases; shows how NIH structures and presents press releases and associated press resources (media contacts, images, subscription). Useful as an example of formatting and the resources expected alongside official releases.

rubrics_metrics.name: News Releases (headline + date + summary)
rubrics_metrics.description: Each entry is presented as a headline followed by a date and a short one-line summary, e.g. "Oral small-molecule GLP-1 drugs penetrate deep into the brain to suppress cravings — May 6, 2026 — NIH-funded research identifies new mechanism of action for next-generation weight-loss drugs".
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Press releases should have a clear, descriptive headline; include the release date; and provide a concise one-line lede or summary that highlights the most newsworthy finding or announcement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media Inquiries / For the Press
rubrics_metrics.description: The page links to Media Inquiries and a 'For the Press' section, indicating that press materials should provide a pathway for media contact and inquiry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include explicit media-inquiry information or a 'For the Press' area so journalists can obtain quotes, interviews, and clarification. Provide media contacts or contact instructions alongside releases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media Contacts
rubrics_metrics.description: A dedicated 'Media Contacts' item is listed in the page navigation and resources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each release or the press office should supply named media contacts (phone/email) or a media contact page so reporters can follow up.

rubrics_metrics.name: Images and B-roll availability
rubrics_metrics.description: The navigation includes an 'Images and B-roll' resource, signaling that releases are accompanied by multimedia assets when available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide accessible high-quality images, b-roll, or other multimedia assets associated with a release to facilitate pickup by news organizations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pick-up and distribution resources
rubrics_metrics.description: The page lists pick-up resources such as 'NIH-Funded Research (EurekAlert.org)', 'NIH Research Matters', and 'NIH News in Health' to promote dissemination of research stories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supply or link to distributions and partner channels (e.g., EurekAlert, institutional news summaries) to broaden reach and provide alternate formats for audiences and journalists.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subscription and RSS availability
rubrics_metrics.description: The page offers 'Subscribe to news releases' and an 'RSS Feed' option for users to receive updates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offer subscription mechanisms (email lists, RSS) so media and stakeholders can be notified of new releases automatically.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pagination and archive access
rubrics_metrics.description: The release index is paginated (Page 1, Page 2, …183) to provide access to historical releases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain an organized, paginated archive so older releases remain discoverable and searchable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintenance / review date
rubrics_metrics.description: The page displays 'This page last reviewed on March 10, 2025.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a clear 'last reviewed' or updated date on press pages to indicate currency and institutional maintenance of press materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organizational branding and legal/footer notices
rubrics_metrics.description: Footer includes organization name/address, tagline ('NIH…Turning Discovery Into Health®'), privacy policy, disclaimers, accessibility, and other legal notices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Press pages and releases should include institutional branding and links to legal, privacy, accessibility, and contact information to establish authenticity and compliance.
